overview: The Shissar Bio-Labs are the birthplace of Shissar bio-arcana, Thought Horror experimentation, and fungal manipulation.
history: The Shissar built the Bio-Labs after arriving on Luclin.
Early Thought Horrors were created here through psychic augmentation.
Shrieker fungal strains were engineered as nutrient processors.
Void fractures corrupted several labs after planar instability increased.
The Shissar abandoned the complex when experiments became uncontrollable.
hooks: Thought Horrors attempt to reclaim their birthplace.
A Shissar relic is discovered in a sealed chamber.
